Captures healthy baseline boot ID 5b620f5a-2111-4f37-b111-4cdf414707cf, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 6b9544fa-4a4e-4b05-ab50-de5ee961ea24, and recovered services, LVM, mount, capacity, and checksummed data.

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /var/lib
fallocate -l 3G /var/lib/lvm-data-pv.img
LOOPDEV=$(losetup --find --show /var/lib/lvm-data-pv.img)
printf 'loop_device=%s\n' "$LOOPDEV"
pvcreate "$LOOPDEV"
vgcreate vg_data "$LOOPDEV"
lvcreate -L 1G -n lv_data vg_data
mkfs.xfs -f -L srv_data /dev/vg_data/lv_data
install -d -m 0755 /srv/data
printf '/dev/mapper/vg_data-lv_data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srv-data-loop.service,x-systemd.after=srv-data-loop.service 0 0\n' >> /etc/fstab
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach the file-backed physical volume for /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service
Before=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/losetup --find --show --nooverlap /var/lib/lvm-data-pv.img
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/pvscan --cache
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_data

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service
mount /srv/data
findmnt /srv/data
